cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: Paper 1 of OCR J271 GCSE Law covers The Legal System and Criminal Law — it is worth 80 marks and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: Paper 1 Section A focuses on The Legal System: law making, the court system, legal personnel and access to justice

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: Paper 1 Section B focuses on Criminal Law: elements of crime, homicide, non-fatal offences, property offences and general defences

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: The paper contains a mix of short-answer questions (1-4 marks), medium-answer questions (5-10 marks) and extended-response questions (15 marks)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: Allocate your time carefully: 90 minutes for 80 marks means roughly 1 minute per mark — spend no more than 15 minutes on a 15-mark question

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: For short-answer questions (1-4 marks), be concise and direct — one clear point per mark, no elaboration needed

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: For medium-answer questions (5-10 marks), make your point, explain it and support with an example — PEEL paragraphs work well

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: For 15-mark questions, use a structured essay format: introduction, two to three paragraphs of balanced analysis, and a justified conclusion

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: In Section A, focus on accuracy of legal terminology — use the correct names for courts, personnel and processes

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: In Section B, problem questions require the ILAC method — identify the offence, state the actus reus and mens rea, apply to the facts, consider defences and conclude

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: Always look at the number of marks — it tells you how much detail is expected. A 2-mark question needs two distinct points; a 15-mark question needs sustained analysis

cards.front: Recall a key point about Paper 1: The Legal System Technique
cards.back: Read each question twice before answering to ensure you have identified the correct command word and topic

cards.front: What should you know about gcse law exam tips — paper 1: the legal system technique?
cards.back: 1. For Paper 1: The Legal System Technique questions, identify the relevant area of law and state the legal principles clearly 2. Apply legal rules to the facts of the scenario — don't just state the law 3. When evaluating, consider both the effectiveness and fairness of legal rules 4. Reference relevant cases and statutes when discussing Paper 1: The Legal System Technique 5. Consider reform proposals and alternative approaches where relevant
